lines.en: Good morning, Paulo. I understand you wish to make a formal complaint about your stay with us.
lines.pt: Bom dia, Paulo. Entendo que você deseja fazer uma reclamação formal sobre a sua estadia conosco.

lines.en: Yes. When we arrived, our room had already been given to another guest, and nobody had warned us.
lines.pt: Sim. Quando chegamos, o nosso quarto já tinha sido dado a outro hóspede, e ninguém nos tinha avisado.

lines.en: I am very sorry. The booking system was being repaired that week, so some mistakes were made.
lines.pt: Sinto muito. O sistema de reservas estava sendo consertado naquela semana, por isso alguns erros foram cometidos.

lines.en: That is no excuse. We had paid in advance, and we were kept waiting in the lobby for two hours.
lines.pt: Isso não é desculpa. Tínhamos pago adiantado, e fomos deixados esperando no saguão por duas horas.

lines.en: I understand. You will be offered a full refund, and the manager will contact you in writing.
lines.pt: Entendo. Será oferecido a você um reembolso total, e o gerente entrará em contato por escrito.

lines.en: I would also like the taxi to be paid for, because we had to go to another hotel.
lines.pt: Eu também gostaria que o táxi fosse pago, porque tivemos que ir para outro hotel.

lines.en: Of course. If the receipt is sent to us, the costs will be reimbursed within ten days.
lines.pt: Claro. Se o recibo for enviado a nós, os custos serão reembolsados em até dez dias.

lines.en: Ten days is too long. Last year my complaint was ignored until I had called three times.
lines.pt: Dez dias é muito tempo. No ano passado minha reclamação foi ignorada até eu ter ligado três vezes.

lines.en: That should never have happened. Your case is being handled by our senior team right now.
lines.pt: Isso nunca deveria ter acontecido. O seu caso está sendo tratado agora pela nossa equipe sênior.

lines.en: Thank you. I would like the apology to be confirmed in a formal letter, please.
lines.pt: Obrigado. Eu gostaria que o pedido de desculpas fosse confirmado em uma carta formal, por favor.

lines.en: It will be sent today. We hope that you will give us another chance.
lines.pt: Ela será enviada hoje. Esperamos que você nos dê outra chance.

words.ex: A complaint is a protest about bad service.
A refund is money given back.
To reimburse is to pay back money.
An apology says that you are sorry.
The lobby is the big entrance room.
A receipt shows that you paid.

teach.goal: Ponte português → inglês com palavras úteis.
solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.
group: Palavras: complaint, refund, reimburse, apology, lobby, receipt.
Aluno diz em português um uso real, depois a palavra em inglês.
extra90: Cada aluno escolhe a palavra mais útil e explica por quê.

facts.big: had been + particípio · is/was being + particípio
facts.label: Passivo e past perfect formais
facts.sub: Past perfect passivo: had been given. Passivo contínuo: was being repaired. Futuro passivo: will be reimbursed. Use I would like… para pedir.

facts.label: Had been + particípio
facts.sub: Use had been + particípio para dizer o que tinha sido feito antes de outro momento do passado: The room had already been given away. É formal e foca no fato, não em quem o fez. Ótimo em reclamações escritas.

facts.label: Is/was being + particípio
facts.sub: Use is being ou was being para uma ação em andamento: The system was being repaired. Your case is being handled. Soa profissional e educado, porque não aponta culpados.

compare.ask: The room had been given away.

compare.us: Em inglês, o passivo é be + particípio; o past perfect é had + particípio.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A formal complaint is often made in writing.
We use the passive to focus on what was done, not on who did it.
Past perfect describes something that happened before another past event.

pages.title: A formal complaint at the hotel · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey morning in Boston, and the lobby of a large hotel is quiet. Paulo had a very bad weekend. He has brought his booking and receipts. Joy works in customer service. She knows that a calm tone works best. Today Paulo wants an explanation, a refund and an apology.

“Good morning, Paulo. I understand you wish to make a formal complaint about your stay with us.” says Joy. “Yes. When we arrived, our room had already been given to another guest, and nobody had warned us.” says Paulo. “I am very sorry. The booking system was being repaired that week, so some mistakes were made.” says Joy.
